summary: Build a professional Minecraft server store website for Aura MC styled like Apple MC/Blockfun Store with a categorized product catalog (Lifesteal, Token SMP, Aura SMP, BoxPVP) plus a new Bundle option, add-to-cart and view cart flow, and a checkout/transaction page supporting UPI-only payments priced in INR (₹). Homepage includes "Happy Gaming"/"Happy Shopping", "Farm the Aura" hero text, Discord link, server IP, animated Aura MC branding, and a View Cart entry; checkout collects in-game name plus Discord name and UPI UTR, includes delivery-time notice and support/footer messaging, and the UI uses professional emojis/icons and imagery plus a "Mini Game Store" coming-soon section.
architectural_notes: Payments limited to UPI only (no other payment methods).
Checkout must collect both Discord name and Minecraft in-game name; instruct users to enter exact names.
Add clear notices: delivery may take time; purchases are for in-game items only; include Discord support link in footer.
Include Minecraft-themed background imagery on every page; add a store-like image/illustration on the cart page for extra polish.
Add a top-level "Bundle" category/option alongside Lifesteal/Token SMP/Aura SMP/BoxPVP and ensure its bundle item details and ₹1750 price are displayed exactly as specified.
Homepage must include "Farm the Aura" hero text and the Aura MC branding should include tasteful animations (without harming readability/performance).

existing_features.title: Create a professional, Apple-like storefront homepage for the Minecraft server store named "Aura MC" with the following visible elements: (1) headline text "Happy Gaming" and "Happy Shopping", (2) server IP displayed as "play.auramc.xyz", (3) a Discord call-to-action that links to https://discord.gg/P8ZVVXYJAf, and (4) primary navigation tiles/buttons for: Lifesteal, Token SMP, Aura SMP, BoxPVP, plus a clearly visible "View Cart" entry point.

Implement a store catalog UI that matches the requested category → subcategory → items flow, where clicking each top-level category reveals its subcategories, and clicking a subcategory reveals purchasable items with names and INR prices shown with the ₹ symbol. Catalog structure and prices must exactly match the provided list for Lifesteal, Token SMP, Aura SMP, and BoxPVP.

Add an "Add to Cart" flow for every purchasable item in the catalog, with a cart state that supports: adding items, adjusting quantity (if the same item is added multiple times), removing items, and showing a running subtotal in INR (₹).

Create a dedicated "View Cart" page/route that includes a "Proceed to Transaction" (checkout) action, and from there a transaction page that supports UPI-only checkout (no other payment methods shown). The transaction page must collect buyer details needed to fulfill the purchase (at minimum: Minecraft username and a field for UPI payment reference/UTR), display the final total in ₹, and allow submitting an order/transaction request.

Apply a coherent, professional visual theme inspired by premium tech storefronts (clean layout, strong typography, product cards, consistent spacing) while still fitting a Minecraft server store. Avoid a blue/purple primary palette; use a distinct color system and apply it consistently across home, catalog, cart, and checkout.
Add generated static brand assets for Aura MC (logo + homepage banner/background) and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not serve images from the backend).

Wire the frontend transaction/checkout submission to the backend createOrder method, and after successful submission show an order confirmation view that displays: order id, Minecraft username, UPI UTR/reference, purchased items (name, quantity, unit price in ₹), and final total in ₹.

Update the checkout/transaction form to collect both (1) Discord name and (2) Minecraft in-game name, and show an explicit instruction that users must enter both names exactly as they appear in Discord/Minecraft.

Persist the buyer’s Discord name with each order: extend the backend order payload and stored order data to include a Discord name field, and return it in order confirmation queries so the frontend can display it.

Add storefront messaging requested by the user: (1) on the cart page, display a clear disclaimer that the user is paying real money for in-game items; (2) on checkout and/or order confirmation, display a clear notice that delivery can take time; (3) add a support callout pointing users to the Discord link, and add “By Aura MC” branding text at the end of the page/footer.
Add a “Mini Game Store (Coming Soon)” section to the homepage as a visible, non-clickable coming-soon area that matches the rest of the professional storefront design.

Add professional emojis/icons to the UI for the store categories and subcategories (coins, ranks, money; Lifesteal, Token SMP, Aura SMP, BoxPVP) and improve the visual polish while keeping all user-facing text in English.
Update the site footer to remove the caffeine.ai promotional copy and instead show Aura MC branding plus the requested support message pointing users to Discord.

Add Minecraft-themed background imagery across the storefront pages (Home, Category/Catalog, Cart, Checkout, and Order Confirmation) so each page has a consistent Minecraft-like background while preserving readability of all text and UI elements.
Add a professional store-like Minecraft-themed image/illustration to the Cart page to increase visual polish, without reducing the clarity of cart items, totals, and the disclaimer text.
Add a new top-level store option named "Bundle" alongside the existing top-level options (Lifesteal, Token SMP, Aura SMP, BoxPVP) so users can browse and purchase a bundle.
Implement the Bundle catalog content exactly as specified: a single purchasable bundle item priced in INR (₹1750) with the listed included rewards and the note that it is valid in any 1 realm.
Update the homepage hero section to prominently include the phrase "Farm the Aura" using a high-quality display font style that matches the site’s premium/professional aesthetic.
Add subtle, professional animations for Aura MC branding across the site (e.g., logo/brand text animation in the header and/or hero), without reducing readability or performance.

Enhance the header cart entry point to show INR context by displaying the current cart subtotal formatted in ₹ next to the cart button when the cart is not empty (while keeping the existing cart item count indicator).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create Aura MC Minecraft server store website with professional design inspired by Apple MC/Blockfun Store
Homepage: show 'Happy Gaming' and 'Happy Shopping', Discord invite link, server IP (play.auramc.xyz), and navigation to 4 store categories + View Cart
Store catalog/category navigation: Lifesteal, Token SMP, Aura SMP, BoxPVP with subcategories and listed items/prices
Shopping cart: add-to-cart functionality, View Cart page, show prices in INR (₹/rupees)
Checkout/transaction page from View Cart with UPI-only payment option

Implement backend order storage and retrieval in the single Motoko actor: persist submitted orders (cart line items, quantities, total ₹ amount, buyer Minecraft username, UPI reference/UTR, timestamp, and a generated order id). Provide canister methods used by the frontend to create an order and to fetch an order by id for confirmation display.

Implement backend order persistence in the single Motoko actor: when a user submits checkout/transaction details, create and store an Order containing (1) generated order id, (2) line items (product name, unit price in ₹, quantity), (3) computed total in ₹, (4) buyer Minecraft username, (5) UPI payment reference/UTR, and (6) timestamp.
Expose backend canister methods for checkout flow: (1) createOrder(payload) -> orderId and (2) getOrderById(orderId) -> order details for confirmation display.
Checkout form: collect Discord name + in-game name (with instruction to enter exact names), include delivery may take time notice, and show footer/support text directing users to Discord

Add storefront messaging and UX polish: cart disclaimer that payment is for in-game items; add professional emojis/icons for categories (coins, ranks, money, Lifesteal, Token SMP, Aura SMP, BoxPVP) and a 'Mini Game Store (Coming Soon)' section
Add Minecraft-themed background imagery across all pages (home/catalog/cart/checkout), including a store-like image in the cart, to improve visual polish

Add a new top-level "Bundle" option on the homepage/catalog with a bundle item (₹1750) listing included rewards (5🔑 top keys, 3 months top rank, 750🪙 coins, 10M 💸 money) and note it's valid in any 1 realm
Homepage hero copy: add prominent "Farm the Aura" text in a good font, and add subtle animations for Aura MC branding across the site
